<function name="IsParent" parent="menubar" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Checks if the supplied panel is parent to the menubar</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="pnl" type="Panel">The panel to check</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is parent or not</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
